phases: Fill the mold with loose soil mix
Swing the lid back on by its handle
Stand the yoke up: cam pin drops into the scoops
Locked over centre: brick pressed to 4 in
Raise the handle: piston drops away from the brick
Drop the latch over the cross bar
Tilt handle and yoke back onto the fixed pins
Lift the lid by its handle and swing it over onto the stand
Push the handle down to eject the brick
Lift the brick off and stack it
Let the handle rise: piston drops for the next fill
